results.detail: Expression confirmed: having ABS(sum(isnull(gen_accountbalance,0)) - isnull(gen_agentvalue,0)+isnull(gen_agencyvalue,0)) > 1 (DTSX:5090); gen_agencyvalue is added. The ownership assumption is labelled. (א) is acceptable as the steady-state case (after a successful update and unchanged balances the term is ABS(2*sum)). The opposite-sign remark is correctly hedged ('עשוי'). But (ב) states an outcome that depends on data as unconditional: 'גם כשהסכום שווה ל-gen_agentvalue, התנאי הוא ABS(gen_agencyvalue) > 1, והצירוף נשלף ונכתב מחדש'. The combination is fetched and rewritten only IF |gen_agencyvalue| > 1; e.g. an agency whose gen_agencyvalue is NULL/0 (an agency that never got a no-agent row) gives ABS(0) = 0 and the row is not fetched. The standard requires data-dependent findings to be conditional.

wrongUnits.correct: גם כשהסכום שווה ל-gen_agentvalue התנאי מצטמצם ל-ABS(gen_agencyvalue) > 1; אם |gen_agencyvalue| > 1 אז הצירוף נשלף ונכתב מחדש עם אותו ערך, ואם לא – הוא אינו נשלף.

results.detail: [1],[3]-[10] match the SQL (union all of contract and parent-contract rows, group by agent/agency ids), Conditional Split (Update Agent = !ISNULL(gen_agentsid) order 0, Update Agency = !ISNULL(gen_agencieid) order 1, default output not connected) and the two OLE DB Commands. [2] describes the filter as 'תנאי הפער בין הסכום לבין שני ערכי השווי השמורים ... גדול מ-1'. The natural reading (gap between the sum and the two stored values, i.e. sum vs agentvalue+agencyvalue) does not match the SQL, which is |sum - agentvalue + agencyvalue| > 1. Counter-example: no-agent row with stored gen_agencyvalue = sum -> by the text there is no gap, by the SQL |sum + sum| > 1 and the row IS updated (exactly finding#4 (א)). The text therefore misstates which rows proceed to update.

wrongUnits.problem: Filter described as a gap between the sum and both stored values; the actual expression adds gen_agencyvalue.
wrongUnits.correct: רק צירופים שבהם ABS(סכום − isnull(gen_agentvalue,0) + isnull(gen_agencyvalue,0)) > 1 ממשיכים לעדכון (gen_agencyvalue מתווסף, לא מחוסר; ראו ממצא 4).
